telegram.name: Telegram Notifications
telegram.description: Receive notifications on Telegram when you claim drops.
setup_steps: Go to @BotFather on Telegram
Create a new bot with /newbot command
Save the bot token you receive
Start your new bot by searching for it and clicking /start (or send any message)
Get your Chat ID by opening this URL in browser (replace TOKEN): https://api.telegram.org/botTOKEN/getUpdates
Find your user ID in the response - it's the number in "from": {"id": YOUR_ID}
Enter the token and Chat ID below and click Test Connection
telegram.success: ✓ Telegram connection successful! You will receive drop notifications.
telegram.error: Failed to connect to Telegram. Please check your bot token and chat ID.
telegram.missing_credentials: Please fill in both Bot Token and Chat ID. See setup instructions in the Help tab.
telegram.save_error: Failed to save Telegram settings. Please try again.
telegram.credentials_help: Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. To disable notifications, clear the Chat ID and save.

help.about_text: This application automatically mines timed Twitch drops without downloading stream data.
how_to_use_items: Login using your Twitch account (OAuth device code flow)
The miner will automatically discover campaigns and start mining
Configure priority games in Settings to focus on what you want
Monitor progress in the Main and Inventory tabs
important_notes_items: Do not watch streams on the same account while mining
Requires linked game accounts for drops

helper_login.step_download: Download and run the TDM login helper on your computer.
helper_login.step_instance: Enter this TDM instance address in the helper.
helper_login.step_chrome: Sign into Twitch in the helper's browser, then close all its windows (macOS: quit that browser instance). Leave this helper open; the browser will reopen to verify the session.
helper_login.step_finish: The helper sends the login to TDM automatically. Wait for its result.
helper_login.builds: Helper builds for Linux, macOS and Windows
helper_login.builds_note: Choose the archive for your operating system and TDM version from the release assets. Install Chrome, Chromium or Firefox 143+; Python is not required.
helper_login.copy_manually: Select and copy the address above.
helper_login.setting_help: Allow the helper to log in or replace the Twitch account. This turns off after a successful login. Automatic renewal continues while it is off.
helper_login.save_error: Could not save helper permission. Try again.
helper_login.closed: Helper connection is off. Enable it in Settings to log in or replace the account.
helper_login.ready: Session verified. Current session valid until {expiry}.
helper_login.waiting: Waiting for login from the helper.
helper_login.session_error: Session unavailable. Check the helper's result.
helper_login.renewal: Turning off helper connection does not stop automatic renewal.
helper_login.renewal_error: Automatic renewal needs attention. Enable helper connection in Settings and run the helper again.
helper_login.renewal_unavailable: This saved session needs a new helper login to enable automatic renewal. Allow helper connection in Settings, then run the helper.
helper_login.renewal_retrying: Automatic renewal failed temporarily. TDM is retrying; no new helper login is needed yet.

helper.title: Connect Twitch to TDM
helper.login: Sign into Twitch in the helper's browser, then close all its windows (macOS: quit that browser instance). Leave this helper open; the browser will reopen to verify the session.
helper.sending: Sending the session; waiting for TDM to verify server renewal…
helper.success: Connected. TDM accepted the session and verified server renewal. You can close this helper.
helper.tdm_help: Root URL of your TDM instance
helper.chrome_help: Path to Google Chrome (normally detected automatically)
helper.result_unknown: The result is unknown. Check TDM before trying again.
helper.browser_help: Browser: auto tries installed browsers in order: Chrome → Chromium → Firefox
helper.firefox_help: Path to native Firefox 143+ (also selects Firefox)
helper.browser_conflict: The browser choice and executable path must select the same browser.

errors.destination: Invalid TDM address. Use its http:// or https:// root URL, including the port, without a path, password, query or fragment.
errors.disabled: Helper access is closed. Enable Settings > Allow helper connection in TDM, then run the helper again.
errors.expired: The helper connection expired or was invalidated. Check helper access and restart the helper; complete login within 10 minutes.
errors.busy: TDM has too many pending helper connections. Close duplicate helpers and wait up to 10 minutes before retrying.
errors.chrome_missing: Chrome was not found. Install native Chrome, select its executable with --chrome, or use --browser firefox.
errors.firefox_missing: Firefox was not found. Install native Firefox 143+ or select its executable with --firefox.
errors.browser_missing: No supported browser was found. Install native Chrome, Chromium or Firefox 143+ on this desktop.
errors.firefox_version: This Firefox version lacks required capture support. Update Firefox to version 143 or newer, or use Chrome.
errors.browser: The desktop browser could not start or closed early. Run the helper in a desktop session and check the executable path and available resources.
errors.browser_owner: The helper could not verify ownership of the browser. Use a native executable, not a sandbox launcher, and retry.
errors.login_timeout: Twitch login was not completed in time. Restart the helper and finish login and verification in its browser window. After signing in, close all helper browser windows (macOS: quit that instance) and leave the helper open.
errors.network: The helper could not reach TDM reliably. Check the address, network and HTTPS certificate; open that address from this desktop.
errors.redirect: TDM redirected the request. Use the final root URL, including https:// when required; credentials are never forwarded through redirects.
errors.response: TDM returned an invalid helper response. Check that helper and miner versions match and the proxy forwards the helper endpoints.
errors.rejected: TDM rejected the request. Check matching versions, helper access and timestamped miner logs for the specific cause.
errors.server_browser: Chromium could not start on the miner host. For source installs, put chromium or chromium-browser on PATH; for Docker, check the image, resources and logs.
errors.result_unknown: Acceptance could not be confirmed; TDM may already have saved the session. Check Twitch login on TDM's Main tab before retrying. Dashboard Connected alone is not proof.
errors.browser_cleanup: The helper could not confirm that its browser stopped. Check TDM before retrying; close only the helper's browser window.
errors.profile_cleanup: The temporary browser profile could not be deleted. Check TDM before retrying, close the helper's browser and keep remaining profile files private.
errors.browser_protocol: Browser communication failed. Keep its window open, update the browser and use a helper matching TDM. If it persists, report the code and versions.
errors.capture_timeout: No verified Twitch session was captured in time. Check login and Twitch connectivity, then retry with an updated supported browser.
errors.capture_limit: Browser capture exceeded its safety limit. Restart the helper. If repeated, report the code and browser/helper versions.
errors.session_expired: Session proof expired or could not be refreshed. Check the computer clock, restart the helper and complete login promptly.
errors.session_invalid: The captured session was invalid. Use matching helper/miner versions and retry a fresh login; do not edit credential files.
errors.sdk: Twitch browser validation or renewal proof could not be obtained. Check Twitch connectivity and update the browser/helper. No guaranteed workaround is known.
errors.validation: Twitch account or campaign validation failed. Verify login and Twitch Drops access in the helper browser, then retry. No guaranteed workaround is known.
errors.account: The account changed during validation. Restart the helper and stay signed into the same Twitch account throughout.
errors.twitch_network: The helper's validation request to Twitch failed. Check connectivity to Twitch and retry after any outage.
errors.failed: An unexpected helper error occurred. Check TDM before retrying and report the code, helper/browser versions and desktop OS without credentials.
errors.firefox_login: Firefox closed without a saved Twitch login. Run the helper again, finish sign-in and verification, then quit only the helper's Firefox instance.
errors.chromium_missing: Chromium was not found. Install native Chromium, select its executable with --chromium, or use --browser firefox.
errors.login_missing: The browser closed without a saved Twitch login. Run the helper again, finish sign-in and verification, then quit only the helper's browser instance.
